## Column Screen Inset Shaded Test

This tests the `.column-screen-inset-shaded` class which spans screen width with a shaded background.

::: {.column-screen-inset-shaded}
SHADED-CONTENT: This content should span the full width with a light gray/shaded background. The shading helps visually distinguish this section from regular content. In HTML, this creates a full-width band with a subtle background color.
:::

Regular text for comparison (no shading).

The shaded variant is useful for callouts, asides, or sections that need visual emphasis.
